name: Patent Protection
description:
This module provides an introduction to basic concepts of patent law.
Topics covered are:
- subject-matter under protection and prerequisites
- proceedings before the Patent Office
- legal effects of a patent
- the inventor's right to the patent
- assignment and licensing
- enforcing a patent
- termination of a patent
prerequisites: German Business Law 1 and 2 (WI0000027, WI0000030) or corresponding knowledge.
